pr_title: REF: move ExtensionIndex.map to be part of DatetimeLikeArrayMixin.map
pr_body:
Follow-up to #51809.

`ExtensionIndex.map` is only used by the datetime-like indexes (`DatetimeIndex.map` etc.) and contains no index-specific functionality, so shouldn't be an index method.

By moving this method to `DatetimeLikeArrayMixin.map` we simplify the code paths quite a bit when dealing with `DatetimeArray.map` etc. In the next PR I will make  `na_action="ignore"` work as expected and close #51644.

issue_context.title: BUG/API: DTI/TDI/PI/IntervalIndex.map ignore na_action
issue_context.body: Split from #44279, so that issue can be about `Categorical.map` & `CategoricalIndex.map`.

review_comments: `DatetimeArray`/`DatetimeIndex` etc. have numpy dtypes, so using `is_extension_array_dtype`  isn't enough, we need to check for `ExtensionArray` to reach the `.map` method of datetime-likes.
